purpose: Preserve the small superstition-versus-devotion cluster pending the broader Spiritual Life formation owner. It must not justify rebuilding Catholic Life.

claims.text: Healthy sacramental devotion points toward God, prayer, faith and conversion rather than independent object-power.
Treating a sacramental as an automatic mechanism independent of faith or the Church's prayer is a superstition warning sign.
Claims of guaranteed worldly or salvific outcomes from mere possession of an object require rejection or careful correction.
